title: SO-2.03 Provenance, retention and invalidation of organisational knowledge
request: Closes G-SO-14. Source: the master traceability baseline of 31 October 2026 (section 8.3) and, where named, the Scope One addendum (PR #222, docs/scope-one/ADDENDUM-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DELIVERY-REVIEW.md at head a1757a0); 8.3 to 8.6 released for contracting by the owner on 31 Oct 2026. This contract is the design-record stage: it asks for the decision record and builds nothing. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository. The programme decomposition on branch docs/engine-decision-tiers-reconcile (docs/scope-one/programme/) is read for overlap: WP10-01 and WP10-02 define the knowledge status lattice and origin fields of a note; this contract takes none of them and covers retention, deletion, invalidation and derived-record provenance.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: Source attribution, derived-record provenance, retention, deletion and invalidation rules
Preserve source attribution and links to the underlying evidence. Summaries and embeddings must not become an uncontrolled side channel around source permissions.

Respect revocation, retention, deletion obligations and permission changes in indexes, caches, replicas and derived views. Define how already-derived insights are invalidated or re-evaluated when their source access changes.
Record which identity or agent accessed, contributed, transformed or disclosed material organisational knowledge, and under which authority.
